Aerobic ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase attack forms cis-dihydrodiol; distinct from mammalian CYP1A1/1B1 arene-oxide route.
Aerobic aromatic-amine oxidase attacks the amine group; product feeds downstream aerobic catabolism.
AFB1-reductase capacity documented in R. erythropolis and related actinomycetes.
F420-dependent reduction of AFB1 bisfuran ring; disables mammalian CYP1A2/3A4 bioactivation route.
Growth on NDMA as sole N-source documented for Rhodococcus sp. ANM-7.
Aerobic monooxygenase-mediated NDMA oxidation to methylamine and formaldehyde intermediates; distinct from CYP2E1 methylating route.
Azoreductase activity documented in Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron.
Loop-1 beta-glucuronidase encoded and active in B. thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482.
Gut azoreductase reduces azo-linked aromatic-amine precursors, releasing free 4-ABP into the lumen.
Loop-1 beta-glucuronidase deconjugates host AFB1-N7-guanine glucuronide, releasing the free carcinogen for reabsorption.
Napa-type periplasmic nitrate reduction documented for Veillonella parvula.
Oral nitrate reduction to nitrite; nitrite enters acidic stomach where N-nitrosation reactions may occur.
